dataWindowRecommendation.fullHistoryUseFor: structural/directional trends + role templates only (153 maps, patch 2.09-13.05)
dataWindowRecommendation.rationale: Map is structurally stable, but agent balance shifted (Chamber 5.12/6.07 nerfs, Jett Tailwind rework 7.04/9.10, economy/ult-point changes). Episode 9+ (>=9.x) captures the modern roster/economy with a usable 42-map sample; <9.x blends older metas.

pv2PriorsFilter.note: PV-2 priors are PV-2-owned (datasets/derived/priors/, NOT modified here). Recommendation only.
pv2PriorsFilter.suggestedPredicate: filter matches by patch >= '9.0' (numeric major.minor) or season/episode >= 9 when building current-meta priors; keep a separate full-history prior for structural baselines.

mapStructuralStability.Ascent: Ascent's layout has been structurally stable across its history: only minor wall/window/door interaction fixes (e.g. v10.04 B Lane wall non-pennable, v6.0 Market door un-breakable), no site/route rework. So map changes do NOT invalidate older Ascent stats; the meta driver is AGENT balance, not map structure.
